approach.method_basis: The Parent is a task-local genetic algorithm whose offspring are filtered by a Bayesian surrogate before any of them is scored. Each session keeps only its own accepted molecules; every announced batch it breeds a fresh field of 160 de novo molecular graphs by rank-biased quantile parent sampling, connected-fragment crossover and seven atom- and bond-local mutation operators, passes them through a valence envelope for sulfur and a canonical-identity and duplicate admission path, and then fits a Gaussian process on all accepted molecules so far. That surrogate compares molecules by shared local environments, counted rather than merely present, and normalizes its labels by the running mean and spread of the accepted scores. Instead of choosing the ten highest predicted molecules, it draws ten correlated samples from the joint predictive distribution over the whole field and takes the sequentially masked best of each draw, so a molecule that is uncertain can win a draw against a molecule that is merely well predicted. Earlier children of this lineage added the counted-environment comparison, the sampled-residual draw with its cross-candidate correlation, the sulfur gate and, most recently, a stall response: after three consecutive announced batches that fail to improve the best molecule, candidate eligibility narrows to the forty highest predicted members of the field until a batch improves again. One thing has never changed. The surrogate's prior uncertainty is a single global number, so an unfamiliar molecule and a molecule inside the current analogue series are both priced with the confidence the model learned near its own archive, and the search can only stop under-pricing unfamiliar chemistry if something else forces it to buy it.
approach.novelty: This node makes the surrogate's prior uncertainty a function of how far a molecule sits from the chemistry the surrogate has actually been shown. Distance is the molecule's dissimilarity to its nearest accepted neighbour under the similarity the surrogate already computes, and the extra uncertainty enters as a second, independent latent function that is switched off exactly on accepted molecules and grows with the square of that distance. Because the extra component is unobserved, the predicted value of every candidate is arithmetically unchanged and so is the stall-time eligibility list, which is ordered by predicted value: the only thing that moves is how wide the sampled draw is where the model has no neighbours, so unfamiliar chemistry becomes competitive on its own uncertainty rather than through a quota. That is what separates this from everything the siblings tried. The two arms that reserved or redirected evaluations toward distant chemistry overrode the ranking and lost; the round-44 arm gave the model several predictive means and scales while holding the covariance shape fixed, and its uncertainty grew near the archive instead of away from it; one sibling released the stall restriction and one changed retention, neither touching the predictor. Here the covariance shape itself changes, in one declared monotone form at one declared scale, with no fitted latent process, no second model and no new asset.

observed_bottleneck: The one behaviour that limits the Parent is that its surrogate's prior uncertainty does not depend on where a candidate sits relative to what the surrogate has actually seen. The Parent prices every member of its 160-member fresh pool with one accepted-only chronological count-Morgan generalized-Tanimoto Gaussian process at a single global prior amplitude of 1.0, so a candidate's predictive variance can only be reduced from that one ceiling by archive similarity; the ceiling itself, and the score_scale that converts it into score units, are both fitted to the near-archive residual spread. The consequences are on the record for this exact allocator. Chemistry away from the archive is systematically under-bought (n-d527b3b4e2cb: a second generator supplied 24.86 per cent of the field and took 231 of 4,350 evaluations, priced below the graph arm in 433 of 435 batches with the posterior-mean gap widening 0.0257 / 0.1155 / 0.1498 across session thirds; n-36afb69ebdd1: a 640-member field still bought lengthened multi-call products at 1.072 per cent against 1.738 per cent). Overriding the ranking to force those purchases is refuted twice while executing exactly (n-df6911ea1fe2: 870 of 870 reserved picks, forced-group parent-beat 0.0989 against 0.1552 for free picks, refuted; n-82195b802723: archive-far reservation converting at 0.000503 per evaluation against the near half's 0.001243 while the inherited rule's own far-half choices were the best stratum at 0.001767, panel -0.031639, refuted), and the decisive distant purchase in that class was under-predicted by 0.271 at a posterior SD of 0.013. Round 44 then removed the remaining cheap model-side explanation: n-1c27fae8e61d gave the predictor many locations and scales, ran in all fifteen cells with 230 of 435 batches multi-component and zero posterior fallbacks, and its archive-far to archive-near predictive SD ratio nevertheless fell below the single GP's in 435 of 435 batches (1.3942 against 1.7477) because with every component's kernel amplitude held at the inherited value the only new variance term is disagreement between component means, which is largest where components overlap, near the archive. Replaying all 435 of the Parent's own published batches offline (reproducing its logged pool posterior means to 7.4e-14 and all 4,350 logged picks exactly) measures the same defect directly on this Anchor: the far/near predictive SD ratio is 1.7550 on average and above 1.7477 in only 224 of 435 batches, nearest-neighbour archive distance spans 0.036 to 0.874 inside a single pool while the predictive SD responds to it only through the archive-anchored similarity floor, and an oracle-free ablated-cluster split of each session's own accepted archive (390 held-out-chemotype splits) leaves held-out-cluster 95 per cent interval coverage at 0.868 against nominal 0.95, under-covering in 8 of 15 sessions and as low as 0.641. The prior variance, not the number of predictive means, is the object that has never been changed on this lineage. The design evidence this node adds before registration, all oracle-free and recomputed on the Parent's own published logs, is reported with the observables: this node's own pre-registration adds the design evidence the approach's recorded obstacles ask for, all of it oracle-free and recomputed on the Parent's published logs: the inherited far/near SD ratio is 1.7550 and clears 1.7477 in only 224 of 435 batches; the gated prior variance at beta = 2.25 raises it in 435 of 435 batches to a mean 2.060 with the inflation ordered by distance (far multiplier 1.252 against near 1.092 in 435 of 435 batches), which is precisely the geometry the mixture inverted; held-out-chemotype 95 per cent coverage rises from 0.868 to 0.910 over 390 ablated-cluster splits and toward nominal in all eight sessions that under-cover; and the construction reaches allocation without any override, moving the archive-far share of evaluations from 1,142 to 1,649 of 4,350 and changing 1,060 picks, while leaving the stall-time eligible set identical because the predictive mean is arithmetically unchanged. The scale is bound at the lower end of that evidence on purpose: the campaign's two refutations say extra distant purchases convert worse than the inherited rule's own far-half choices, so beta = 2.25 buys a decisive change in the uncertainty geometry at a moderate change in the purchase mix, and the conversion reading, not the calibration reading, is what decides the route.

adoptions.applicability: The paper's object is the same one this lineage's receipts identify, a surrogate whose uncertainty does not grow where its knowledge stops, but its experiments are low-dimensional continuous regression with full posterior inference, while this node has 300 accepted labels per task in ten-member batches, a fixed similarity kernel over molecular count fingerprints and no coordinate space. The principle therefore transfers and the inference does not, so the amplitude is a declared deterministic function of the archive distance the selector already computes, and the paper supplies no effect size for this panel.
adoptions.borrowed_element: The input-varying signal amplitude: the Gaussian process's prior signal variance is an explicit function of the input rather than one globally fitted constant, so predictive uncertainty is allowed to grow in regions the data does not cover.

deviations.adopted_setting: One bounded deterministic gate with one declared form and one declared scale, fitted to nothing, with the lengthscale and the noise left exactly as inherited.
deviations.paper_setting: Latent log-Gaussian-process priors on the signal amplitude, lengthscale and noise, inferred by Hamiltonian Monte Carlo or MAP gradient ascent.
deviations.reason: At 300 accepted observations per task arriving in ten-member batches a latent amplitude process is neither identifiable nor affordable inside the frozen task timeout, and fitting it would confound the single quantity this position exists to move.

deviations.adopted_setting: An additive independent component, cov(x,x') = k(x,x') + s(x) s(x') k(x,x'), with s exactly zero on every accepted record.
deviations.paper_setting: A multiplicative amplitude, cov(x,x') = alpha(x) alpha(x') k(x,x'), applied to the whole kernel including the training and cross blocks.
deviations.reason: The multiplicative form rescales the train-to-pool cross-covariance and therefore the predictive mean and its ordering, which the frozen conditions forbid and which would also move the retained stall-time top-forty eligible set. The additive gated form leaves the fit path, the predictive mean and the eligible set arithmetically unchanged, so the experiment isolates the covariance, and it stays positive semidefinite by construction.

deviations.adopted_setting: Amplitude as a function of the candidate's nearest-neighbour dissimilarity to this session's own accepted archive under the inherited similarity, taken as 1 minus the maximum similarity.
deviations.paper_setting: Amplitude as a function of a Euclidean input coordinate.
deviations.reason: There is no coordinate space for a bred molecular pool, and the statistic must be the one the campaign's own audits use so the reading is comparable to the recorded 1.7477 and 1.3942 figures. The nearest-neighbour statistic was chosen over mean archive similarity on the Parent's own published pools because it discriminates: spread 0.837 against 0.640, interquartile range 0.139 against 0.084, correlation with the inherited predictive SD 0.946 against 0.872, and a median of 0.142 against 0.431, so a mean-similarity gate would inflate almost everywhere and reproduce the global-inflation failure the mixture already demonstrated.

deviations.adopted_setting: Scale bound at 2.25 with exponent 2, declared before execution, with no sweep in either direction after the panel.
deviations.paper_setting: No benchmark objective; the amplitude is fitted per dataset.
deviations.reason: An oracle-free replay of all 435 of the Parent's own announced batches fixed the scale before registration: it raises the archive-far to archive-near predictive SD ratio in 435 of 435 batches with the inflation ordered by distance and moves held-out-chemotype coverage toward nominal, while displacing the purchase mix only moderately, which matters because two recorded arms that forced extra distant purchases converted worse than the inherited rule's own far-half choices.

adoptions.implementation_change: In FingerprintPosterior.distribution the returned pool covariance becomes (K_pp - projection^T projection) + (s outer s) * K_pp with s(x) = sqrt(2.25) * d(x) and d(x) = 1 - max similarity of x to the session's accepted archive under the inherited count-Morgan generalized-Tanimoto kernel, so the prior variance of a candidate is k(x,x)(1 + 2.25 d(x)^2). The gate is computed from the cross matrix the method already builds; fit() and the returned mean expression are untouched.

literature_review.conclusion: The frozen round-45 bottleneck review supplies the external element this position needs, and re-reading the two covariance sources confirms the review's record: Heinonen makes the prior signal amplitude an explicit function of the input and infers it by HMC or MAP, and the Deep Gaussian Covariance Network shows input-dependent kernel parameters and additively combined covariance components are an established, separable design space. Only the input-dependent amplitude principle is adopted, and it is adopted in the additive gated form rather than the paper's multiplicative one so that the predictive mean, the inherited fit path and the retained stall-time eligible set stay arithmetically unchanged and the experiment isolates the covariance. Every parameter is internal: the exponent, the scale 2.25 and the nearest-neighbour distance statistic were fixed before registration by an oracle-free replay of the Parent's own 435 published batches and by 390 ablated-cluster held-out splits of its own accepted archives, neither of which uses an oracle call, a task identity or any label outside the session. Literature origin is not permission to continue: one complete exposed panel ends this recipe, a far/near ratio that does not rise or an inflation that is not ordered by distance reports the implementation and the quantity rather than the endpoint, and a calibration gain without a rise in realized incumbent increments is recorded as the premise refuted with no sweep of the form, the scale or the statistic.

sources.applicability: This is the campaign's recorded defect stated as a model property: the mechanism that makes predictive variance depend on where the input sits, rather than on how many predictive means the model has, which is exactly what the round-44 mixture failed to deliver. Only the input-dependent signal-amplitude principle is adopted, as one bounded deterministic gate on the archive distance the selector already computes. The HMC and MAP inference of latent amplitude and lengthscale processes is not adopted: at 300 accepted observations per task in ten-member batches it is neither affordable inside the frozen task timeout nor identifiable, and the paper's regression experiments carry no effect size for this panel.
sources.finding: Makes the signal variance and the lengthscale explicit functions of the input, with separate Gaussian process priors on their logarithms to keep them positive, and infers them by Hamiltonian Monte Carlo with a gradient-ascent MAP alternative; the authors state it is the first model to combine heteroscedastic noise, a non-stationary lengthscale and an input-varying signal variance. The abstract was re-read for this node and confirms that all three parameters, noise variance, signal variance and lengthscale, can be simultaneously input-dependent and are inferred by HMC or MAP gradient ascent.
sources.title: Non-Stationary Gaussian Process Regression with Hamiltonian Monte Carlo

sources.applicability: Cited only to bound the claim that input-dependent kernel parameters are a known and separable design choice, and that additively combining covariance components is an established construction rather than an invention of this node. Nothing is adopted as a mechanism: training a network to set kernel parameters from 300 accepted labels per session is outside this offline, task-agnostic profile and would confound the one quantity this position is built to move.
sources.finding: Reviews the non-stationary kernel literature and proposes a framework in which a deep neural network predicts the lengthscale and noise variance as functions of the test input, so the covariance structure itself is input-dependent rather than globally fitted. The abstract was re-read for this node and confirms the correlation lengthscales and possibly the noise variance depend on the test point, with several covariance functions combined additively.
sources.title: Deep Gaussian Covariance Network

sources.applicability: Carried forward as the basis of the route this node succeeds, and used here only as the recorded boundary: with each component's kernel amplitude held at the inherited value the construction cannot produce archive-distance-growing uncertainty, which n-1c27fae8e61d measured as a far/near SD ratio falling in 435 of 435 batches. No part of it is adopted; its membership-mass weight rule stays a deliberately deferred question and is not this node's object.
sources.finding: Replaces a single Gaussian process by a Dirichlet-process mixture whose latent regimes are inferred online by collapsed Gibbs sampling with an adaptive concentration schedule, gives each regime its own hyperparameters, and splits acquisition uncertainty into intra-regime and inter-regime parts, reporting gains on synthetic tasks, molecular conformer optimization and virtual screening.
sources.title: Regime-Adaptive Bayesian Optimization via Dirichlet Process Mixtures of Gaussian Processes (RAMBO)

method_change.previous_method: One accepted-only chronological count-Morgan generalized-Tanimoto Gaussian process with a single global prior amplitude of 1.0, whose predictive uncertainty depends on a candidate's position only through the archive-anchored similarity floor, consumed by a correlated Thompson draw over a 160-member fresh pool under a stall-time top-forty eligibility mask.
method_change.proposed_method: The same process with a non-stationary, input-dependent prior variance: an additional independent latent component under the identical kernel, gated to exactly zero on the accepted archive and growing with the square of a candidate's nearest-neighbour archive distance at one declared scale, so the prior variance becomes k(x,x)(1 + 2.25 d(x)^2) while the predictive mean rule, the fit path, the normalization, the noise, the jitter ladder, the sampled-residual correlated draw, the masks and the tie rule stay as inherited.
method_change.rationale: The lineage's bottleneck is recorded in model terms, not ranking terms, and both ranking overrides are refuted while executing exactly (n-df6911ea1fe2, n-82195b802723, h-b2785e70f134cc20, h-8f75b2df9443d3af). Round 44 removed the remaining cheap model-side candidate by measuring that more predictive means and scales under a fixed covariance shape move far-field uncertainty the wrong way in 435 of 435 batches (n-1c27fae8e61d), and h-4dd9850598959272 names an explicit distance-dependent prior variance as one of the untested covariance-level requirements. The scope is one component of the loop: the optimizer, its operators, its admission path, its retention and its acquisition rule are untouched, and at scale zero the construction is bit-identical to the Parent.

hypothesis: Archive-distance-dependent prior variance (non-stationary input-dependent signal amplitude) inside the inherited accepted-only predictor. The latent function is modelled as f(x) = h1(x) + s(x) h2(x) with h1 and h2 independent zero-mean Gaussian processes under the identical inherited count-Morgan generalized-Tanimoto covariance k, and with the gate s(x) = sqrt(beta) * d(x), where d(x) = 1 - max over the session's accepted archive of k(x, archive member) is the candidate's nearest-neighbour archive distance under that same kernel and beta = 2.25 is the one declared scale. The resulting prior covariance is k(x, x') + s(x) s(x') k(x, x'), so the prior variance of a candidate is k(x, x) (1 + beta d(x)^2): it rises monotonically with archive distance and is exactly the inherited prior at distance zero. Because every accepted record has d = 0 by construction (its nearest neighbour is itself at similarity one), the gated component is identically zero on the whole training set: the training covariance, its Cholesky factor, its jitter ladder, the fitted coefficients, the adaptive mean and population-SD normalization with its 0.001 floor, the 0.05 noise SD and the train-to-pool cross-covariance are all arithmetically unchanged, and therefore so is every pool posterior mean, the (-posterior mean, pool index) ordering and the retained stall-time top-forty eligible set. The single change reaching behaviour is the pool's joint predictive covariance consumed by the inherited correlated Thompson draw, which gains the positive semidefinite term s s^T elementwise-multiplied by the pool kernel: the extra uncertainty keeps the inherited similarity as its correlation structure, so cross-candidate correlation (m-000000000007) and sampled residual influence (m-000000000006) stay the channels through which it acts, rather than being replaced by independent per-candidate noise. One (10, 160) standard-normal array per batch in the same generator, order and consumption count, the same sequential masked argmax, the same per-pick mask update, the same first-index tie rule, the same bounded generation-order fallback, and no quota, reserved pick, availability override or post-hoc variance rescaling anywhere. At beta = 0 the construction is bit-identical to the Parent, which is its degenerate control.

finding_summary.headline: Gate ran exactly and recalibrated the far field, but its extra purchases converted at a quarter of the inherited rate: mass 4.75 vs 5.98, panel -0.0817
finding_summary.insights:
The covariance-shape question that round 44 left open is now answered in the affirmative at the model layer and in the negative at the conversion layer. An input-dependent prior amplitude, gated to exactly zero on the accepted archive, does make this predictor's uncertainty grow where its knowledge stops: it raised the far-to-near SD ratio in every batch, ordered the inflation by distance, and improved held-out chemotype coverage toward nominal in every session that under-covered - precisely the geometry the regime mixture inverted. So the recorded defect was real and is now fixable at this layer, and the mixture's failure is confirmed as a property of its construction rather than of the goal. What does not follow is benefit. Better-calibrated far-field uncertainty, delivered through the inherited correlated Thompson draw, bought 625 more archive-far evaluations that returned less mass than the evaluations they displaced. This is the third independent demonstration on this lineage that extra distant purchases convert worse than the inherited rule's own far-half choices, and the first in which the extra purchases were produced by the model's own pricing rather than by a quota or a reservation - which closes the remaining explanation that the earlier failures were artefacts of overriding the ranking. The registered stop condition applies exactly as written, and it forbids a sweep of the warp's form, its scale or the distance statistic: this recipe is finished.

What the trajectories show about the method is more useful than the score. The failure is not in the surrogate's ranking quality, which if anything improved (batch prediction-score rank correlation 0.544 against 0.515); it is in what the distance statistic means. Nearest-neighbour count-fingerprint dissimilarity is maximized as readily by degenerate proposals as by genuinely new scaffolds, so a monotone warp in it reprices both: 28 per cent of the archive-far picks that only the gate bought carry five or fewer heavy atoms, near-empty proposals rose from 91 to 236 of 4,350 evaluations and duplicated-fragment products above 50 heavy atoms from 44 to 344. That mechanism is visible in the two cells that collapsed. In the weakest cell the pool's mean size inflated from about 40 to 74-81 heavy atoms by the third to eighth batch while its incumbent stayed at 0.029 through batch 16 - the Anchor's same-seed cell was past 0.96 by batch 15 - because distance-driven purchases entered the archive, which moved the distance statistic again, a self-reinforcing drift that only broke when the session fell back onto a compact scaffold around batch 17 and ended at 0.4105. In the other weak cell the gate displaced the Anchor's best batch-one pick, the incumbent line lost its aromatic core by batch 10 and spent the remaining nineteen batches refining a non-aromatic caged core to 0.4335 while the same-objective sibling cells, which kept an aromatic core, reached 0.56-0.67; the molecular report reads the same cells the same way, with no aromatic ring in that cell's top band. Because the gate acts in every batch rather than in the 88 restricted ones, it displaced the Anchor's best batch-one pick in 7 of 15 cells, so cell-level dispersion is part of the cost, not noise around it.

What this narrows for the campaign: calibrating the covariance is not the binding constraint, and neither is the ranking - the binding constraint is that widening a Thompson draw converts uncertainty into purchases without pricing the downside of the candidate it buys, and that the archive-distance statistic this lineage uses conflates novelty with degeneracy. Two kinds of method, not parameters, follow from that. First, a value rule rather than a wider draw: an acquisition that scores a candidate's expected gain against its risk (an improvement-based or risk-averse ranking over the same calibrated posterior) would let the better-calibrated far field inform the choice without automatically buying it. Second, a proposal or admission class that makes distance mean scaffold novelty - a size-and-composition envelope on candidates, or group-level rather than single-atom proposal moves - so that the far half of a pool is populated by coherent alternative chemistry instead of fragments and duplication products; the molecular report's independent reading of this node's output asks for the same thing, and the two sibling tickets running this round touch exactly those two layers. Also still open: this arm raises only the far-field ceiling, so the inherited posterior's much larger near-archive overconfidence is untouched and remains a separate, unmeasured object.
finding_summary.results:
Construction: in all 435 announced batches of all 15 sessions the gate was computed and consumed, and nothing else moved. Every pool posterior mean matched the ungated recomputation to exactly 0.0 (float64 identity, not a tolerance), the posterior-mean ordering was identical in 435 of 435 batches, the retained stall-time top-forty eligible set was identical in all 90 restricted batches, all 4,200 probed accepted records received gate exactly 0.0, the gate was monotone in logged archive distance in 435 of 435 pools, and the fitted normalization, the 0.05 noise SD and the 1e-8 training jitter equalled the Anchor's. Batch one is byte-comparable: identical pools, identical posterior means, identical standard-normal rows, and the passive ungated replay reproduced the Anchor's own ten picks in 15 of 15 cells. Cost and stability held: 870 factorizations with zero failures and no jitter escalation above 1e-8, zero posterior fallbacks, no pool truncation, and about 0.3 added seconds per session against per-cell wall times of 29 to 201 seconds inside a 7,200-second timeout.

The uncertainty geometry moved as predicted, and more cleanly than the refuted round-44 mixture did. The archive-far to archive-near predictive SD ratio rose above the ungated model's on identical pools in 435 of 435 batches and in all 15 session means (gated mean 1.974 against base 1.697), clearing the inherited 1.7477 reference in 409 of 435 batches against the base's 138. The inflation was ordered, not global: the archive-far half inflated 1.231 against the near half's 1.080 in 435 of 435 batches, with no batch in which the near half inflated at least as much, and the per-decile prior-variance inflation rose monotonically with distance in 435 of 435 batches. Oracle-free held-out-chemotype calibration over 390 cluster splits improved on both registered clauses: pooled 95 per cent coverage of held-out chemotype clusters rose from 0.830 to 0.882, all nine sessions that under-covered under the inherited model moved toward nominal (the worst from 0.376 to 0.463, another from 0.662 to 0.844), the six sessions already at or above nominal only over-covered further and are not counted, and the cluster-to-random standardized error ratio fell below the inherited model's in 11 of 15 sessions.

Allocation moved without any quota: the ten picks differed from the passive ungated replay in 402 of 435 batches, 1,284 of 4,350 picks changed, the archive-far share of accepted evaluations rose from the Anchor's 1,142 of 4,350 (26.25 per cent) to 1,767 of 4,350 (40.62 per cent), and the mean posterior-mean rank of purchases moved from 29.2 to 40.8 on the same pools. In the 90 restricted batches the eligible set was identical and the gate only reordered picks inside it (1.99 changed picks per restricted batch at mean rank 13.4 against 13.1).

The conversion clause failed. Realized best-so-far increment mass fell from the Anchor's 5.978073 over 253 improvements to 4.752540 over 250, a 20.5 per cent loss, and the archive-far share of that mass fell from 25.1 to 13.6 per cent. Per evaluation, archive-far purchases converted at 0.000366 against the Anchor's own far-half rate of 0.001312, while near purchases rose slightly (0.001590 against 0.001397). Splitting purchases by whether the ungated replay would also have made them: the 690 archive-far picks that only the gate bought returned 0.000232 of mass per evaluation and 19 incumbent improvements, against 0.001752 per evaluation for the 2,333 near picks both rules agreed on. The fifteen-cell panel fell on all three seeds: seed macros 0.580392 / 0.540161 / 0.455431 against 0.649701 / 0.585234 / 0.586156, paired mean -0.081702 against a registered minimum effect of +0.002. That is outside this round's law-free band measured on the same Anchor, [-0.055482, +0.014579], but the excess is carried by one cell: with the weakest cell removed the remaining fourteen average -0.047322, inside the band. Both fragile high cells lost as the intent anticipated (-0.247 and -0.093). The increment-mass loss does not depend on the two weak cells: removing both still leaves 3.930 against 4.381, a 10.3 per cent fall.

Nearest-neighbour count-fingerprint dissimilarity is maximized as readily by degenerate proposals as by genuinely new scaffolds, so a monotone warp in it reprices both: 28 per cent of the archive-far picks that only the gate bought carry five or fewer heavy atoms, near-empty proposals rose from 91 to 236 of 4,350 evaluations and duplicated-fragment products above 50 heavy atoms from 44 to 344. That mechanism is visible in the two cells that collapsed. In the weakest cell the pool's mean size inflated from about 40 to 74-81 heavy atoms by the third to eighth batch while its incumbent stayed at 0.029 through batch 16 - the Anchor's same-seed cell was past 0.96 by batch 15 - because distance-driven purchases entered the archive, which moved the distance statistic again, a self-reinforcing drift that only broke when the session fell back onto a compact scaffold around batch 17 and ended at 0.4105. In the other weak cell the gate displaced the Anchor's best batch-one pick, the incumbent line lost its aromatic core by batch 10 and spent the remaining nineteen batches refining a non-aromatic caged core to 0.4335 while the same-objective sibling cells, which kept an aromatic core, reached 0.56-0.67; the molecular report reads the same cells the same way, with no aromatic ring in that cell's top band. Because the gate acts in every batch rather than in the 88 restricted ones, it displaced the Anchor's best batch-one pick in 7 of 15 cells, so cell-level dispersion is part of the cost, not noise around it.

What this narrows for the campaign: calibrating the covariance is not the binding constraint, and neither is the ranking - the binding constraint is that widening a Thompson draw converts uncertainty into purchases without pricing the downside of the candidate it buys, and that the archive-distance statistic this lineage uses conflates novelty with degeneracy. Two kinds of method, not parameters, follow from that. First, a value rule rather than a wider draw: an acquisition that scores a candidate's expected gain against its risk (an improvement-based or risk-averse ranking over the same calibrated posterior) would let the better-calibrated far field inform the choice without automatically buying it. Second, a proposal or admission class that makes distance mean scaffold novelty - a size-and-composition envelope on candidates, or group-level rather than single-atom proposal moves - so that the far half of a pool is populated by coherent alternative chemistry instead of fragments and duplication products; the molecular report's independent reading of this node's output asks for the same thing, and the two sibling tickets running this round touch exactly those two layers. Also still open: this arm raises only the far-field ceiling, so the inherited posterior's much larger near-archive overconfidence is untouched and remains a separate, unmeasured object.

molecular.headline: Ring-rich 22-35 heavy-atom cores decorated atom-by-atom with halogens; two cells drifted onto caged aminal cores with no basic amine
molecular.overall_character: Across all five objectives the node proposed one chemotype per cell and then edited it atom by atom. The sets are ring-rich and mostly aromatic (digest ring_closure_rate 0.9207-0.9598, aromatic_atom_rate 0.7184-0.9368) and sit at 22-35 heavy atoms on four objectives (digest mean_smiles_length 39.8-78.3), with no stereochemistry and no ionizable species anywhere (stereocentre_rate 0.0 and charged_rate 0.0 on every task). The dominant move visible in the molecules is single-atom substitution, overwhelmingly halogen or chalcogen: halogen_rate is 0.7828-0.9747 on four of the five objectives, yet in 4350 valid proposals I found no single CF3 group, no triazole ring and only seven piperazine rings, so the generator fluorinates atoms but never assembles a fluorinated or basic group. Those single-atom swaps frequently land on heteroatoms, giving N-F, O-F, S-F, O-Cl and S-S bonds that a chemist would not accept; the digest's own worst lists are full of them (OCl, SOCl, BrBr, C=COF, FSF). Size control fails at both ends: 236 of 4350 proposals carry five heavy atoms or fewer (Cl, BrBr, C, C#C, F, NS, CC all appear as scored proposals), while one cell spent 161 of its 290 proposals above 50 heavy atoms assembled by duplicating an inherited fragment (that task's digest max_smiles_length is 227). The best molecules per objective are nevertheless recognisable medicinal-chemistry shapes - an aminergic chloroaryl/N-methylazetidine amine, an ethoxyquinoline fused to a methyl diketopiperazine, a benzo-fused ketone carboxamide - which makes the exotica in the two weak cells look like a failure of proposal quality rather than an absence of good chemistry in the generator's repertoire.

Three rings, two to three of them aromatic, no basic centre, no stereocentre, and the digest's halogen_rate of 0.7828 with ring_closure_rate 0.9391 matches that reading.

What separates 0.67 from 0.43 in the molecules is the presence of an aromatic heterocycle plus a phenolic aryl, which the weak cell abandoned early and never rebuilt; the strong cell's final-band molecules keep it (C=C(C=CC=Cn1cc2c(c1CCF)c(=N)n(F)c(=O)n2C)C(=O)F at 0.5592).

transferable_gaps.evidence: Halogen substitution is its most frequent visible move (digest halogen_rate 0.7828, 0.8034, 0.9747 and 0.8345 on four of the five objectives), yet in the 4350 valid molecules I read from this node's trajectories there is not one CF3 group, and the fluorine-rich endpoint molecules carry CHF2, CH2F and N-F instead (O=C1OSCC2=C3CC(C(F)F)C4=C5CON(F)C(=O)N(CC(F)N4C3C1=C2)C5=O).
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator never assembles a multi-atom halogenated substituent; it only substitutes single halogen atoms.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Proposals need a group-level substitution unit: a small vocabulary of whole substituents (trifluoromethyl, methanesulfonyl, nitrile, carboxamide) inserted as one move, so that a chemically coherent group can appear in a single step instead of having to be assembled atom by atom through low-scoring intermediates.

transferable_gaps.evidence: N-F, O-F, S-F, O-Cl and S-S bonds are pervasive: my count over this node's proposals finds heteroatom-halogen bonds in 50-66 percent of the molecules in every cell of one objective and in up to 81 percent of the molecules in individual cells of two others, and the digest's own worst lists contain OCl, SOCl, C=COF, FSF and BrBr as scored proposals, with OC(F)Br and n(F) appearing even inside the best molecules.
transferable_gaps.gap: Halogen and chalcogen substitutions are placed on heteroatoms, producing bonds no chemist would accept.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Substituent placement should be restricted by the element it attaches to: halogens onto carbon only, unless the move inserts a recognised group. Without that rule a large share of every batch is spent on molecules that are unmakeable regardless of their predicted value.

transferable_gaps.evidence: On the one objective where the inherited population amplified an amine, 64-91 percent of proposals carry a basic nitrogen and all twenty top molecules do (CN1CCC1(CCNC1(c2ccccc2CCl)CCN1C)c1cc(N)ccc1Cl); on three other objectives the rate stays at 2-11 percent and the top molecules have none. Across 4350 proposals I found only 7 piperazine rings and 27 primary amines on an sp3 chain.
transferable_gaps.gap: A basic amine centre is never created where the lineage does not already carry one.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The move set needs an explicit nitrogen-installation operation on saturated rings: convert a ring CH2 to NH or NMe, or attach a small saturated N-heterocycle. At present an ionizable centre can only be inherited and decorated, never introduced, and the generator emits no charged or zwitterionic species at all (charged_rate 0.0 on all five objectives).

transferable_gaps.evidence: 236 of the 4350 proposals have five or fewer heavy atoms and score at or near zero (Cl, BrBr, SOCl, C, C#C, NS, CC, F all appear in the digest's worst lists), while one cell spent 161 of its 290 proposals above 50 heavy atoms, built by joining two copies of an inherited fragment (O=C(C1CCC2c3c(Cl)cc(Cl)cc3S(=O)(=O)N12)C1CCC2c3c(Cl)cc(Cl)cc3S(=O)(=O)N12 at 0.0287); that cell's digest max_smiles_length is 227 against a mean of 78.3.
transferable_gaps.gap: Proposal size is uncontrolled at both extremes: near-empty fragments and duplicated-fragment conjugates.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Candidate construction needs a two-sided size and complexity envelope relative to the current incumbents, and the duplication-style crossover that doubles a molecule should not be the main way size changes. Both tails are paid for with scored evaluations that cannot inform anything.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Ring closures are everywhere (digest ring_closure_rate 0.9207-0.9598) but aromatic content is inherited: in one cell every one of the twenty highest-scoring molecules has zero aromatic rings and roughly four bridgehead atoms (O=C1OSCC2=C3CC(C(F)F)C4=C5CON(F)C(=O)N(CC(F)N4C3C1=C2)C5=O) while sibling cells on the same objective hold two to three aromatic rings throughout (Cn1ccn(-c2cc(F)ccc2O)c(C2=CN(F)C2F)c(F)c(=N)n(C)c1=O).
transferable_gaps.gap: Aromatic ring systems can only be edited in place, not constructed, so a lineage that loses aromaticity cannot recover it.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The operator set needs a ring-construction move that closes a valid aromatic ring, and ideally a core-replacement move that swaps one ring system for another of similar size. Atom-wise editing inside an inherited ring system makes aromaticity a one-way loss.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Cumulated double bonds reach digest cumulated_double_bond_rate 0.1034 and 0.0586 on two objectives, and in one cell I counted allene or cumulene chains in 86 percent of proposals. Acyl fluorides (C(=O)F), acyl hydrazides (C(=O)N(N)), thioamide-aminals, ring sulfenate esters (C(=O)OS) and bridged N-C-N aminals all appear inside the highest-scoring molecules, not only in the discards.
transferable_gaps.gap: Strained and labile motifs are proposed at high frequency because nothing filters proposal stability.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: A structural-admissibility screen on the proposal itself, applied before any surrogate or oracle cost is spent, would remove a recurring class of molecules whose score cannot be acted on chemically; the generator currently treats these motifs as ordinary decorations.

transferable_gaps.evidence: stereocentre_rate is 0.0 in the digest on all five objectives, while the molecules themselves are full of stereogenic sp3 centres: bridged aminal tricycles (O=S1(=O)Cc2c(ccc(Cl)c2O)C2CNC(c3cc(O)cc(O)c3)N21) and caged pentacycles with about four bridgehead atoms per molecule.
transferable_gaps.gap: No stereochemistry is ever expressed, although the generator routinely proposes sp3-rich bridged cages.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Either the representation should carry and mutate stereo descriptors, or the generator should prefer conformationally defined ring systems; as it stands every sp3-rich proposal is an undefined mixture, which silently discards one of the few remaining degrees of freedom once a core is fixed.

method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
